name: Los Cabos
tagline: Desert meets sea at the tip of Baja
summary: Los Cabos sits where the Baja desert meets the Pacific and the Sea of Cortez. Boat out to the famous rock arch, snorkel at Chileno Bay, watch whales in winter and explore San José del Cabo's art district.
seasonNote: Winter is warm, dry and whale season. Summer is very hot with hurricane risk.
arrival: Los Cabos Airport is near San José del Cabo.
gettingAround: Rent a car or use shuttles; buses run the corridor.
cashTip: Carry pesos for taxis, tacos and markets; cards work in hotels and bigger restaurants. Pay in pesos, not dollars, for a better rate.
foodTip: Fish tacos, chocolate clams and Baja wine.
buyTip: Art in San José del Cabo.
baseArea: Cabo San Lucas for nightlife; San José for calm
coverWiki: El Arco de Cabo San Lucas
